new_sources.summary: Names Liqui Moly2.5/3wt for the KYB shock. This corroborates an OEM US service-product recommendation, but the operation changes the original stop plate/stack with a lowering spacer. It provides no final charge or explicit equivalence to K2C.

clarification_assessment.fluid: Multiple OEM US service documents recommend Liqui Moly. No reviewed statement identifies K2C equivalence, supersession, or factory-fill versus service-fill conditions.
clarification_assessment.pressure: No exact source explains the147/150psi discrepancy, measurement reference, temperature or accepted tolerance.
clarification_assessment.changed_stack: Lowering-kit shaft nut instruction is30Nm; it cannot silently replace the stock-service34Nm instruction because the assembly and operation differ.

resolution_requires: Exact OEM/component service clarification identifying accepted final charge and pressure reference for the stock2023 C46.
Explicit accepted service-fluid equivalence or source applicability/supersession clarification.
